newsitem.title: PERU: Lima share prices end little changed in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Lima share prices end little changed in thin trade.

text.p: Shares on the Lima Stock Exchange closed broadly stable Friday and continued the week's general trend of low volumes as foreign investors remained sidelined, brokers said.
The trend was seen little changed next week as investors believed the Peruvian market's short-term upside was limited and looked to other markets in the region for their profits, they said.
Friday, the General Index fell 0.10 percent to 2,017.2 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index edged up 0.01 percent to 2,911.8 points.
In a total of 1,421 trades, volume was 31.0 million soles ($11.7 million).
"Basically, foreigners are absent and local investors' money has dried up," Gustavo Bedoya of local brokerage Prisma said, explaining the current period of apathy on the bolsa.
Benchmark Telefonica del Peru closed stable at 6.34 soles on volume of 967,000 shares.
The country's top cement company, Cementos Lima, closed down 1.46 percent at 5.41 soles on volume of 294,000 shares.
Electricity distributor Edegel gained most among leaders, closing up 3.77 percent at 1.10 soles, on volume of 572,000 shares.
